question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. ADULATION
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Flattery**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Adulation"** refers to excessive admiration or praise for someone, often to the point of being insincere. (अत्यधिक प्रशंसा)

 
 
• **Example: **The celebrity was used to constant adulation from her fans wherever she went.
 

 
• **"Flattery"** is a synonym of "Adulation" and means insincere or excessive praise, often used to gain favor or advantage. (चापलूसी)

 
 
• **Example: **He used flattery to win the trust of his superiors.
 

 
• Since "Flattery" is the closest synonym to "Adulation," it is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Flattery**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Condemnation** (निंदा): The expression of strong disapproval or criticism.
 
 
• **Example:** The government faced condemnation for its failure to address climate change.
 
 

 
• **Devotion** (भक्ति): Love, loyalty, or enthusiasm for someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** Her devotion to her family is truly admirable.
 
 

 
• **Praise** (प्रशंसा): The expression of approval or admiration for someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher praised the student for her excellent performance in the exam.
